title: His Bundle Pacing Versus Right Ventricular Pacing
brief_summary: This study will randomize cross-over periods of 6 months of right ventricular pacing and His bundle pacing in patients with baseline left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF)\>40%. The primary outcome measure is LVEF.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Baseline LVEF\>40%
* Standard pacing indication with \>20% VP
* Functional His bundle lead with confirmed His capture
* Functional right ventricular lead with myocardial capture

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to sign an informed consent form
